our_interpretation: The statement expresses a tentative assessment of readiness at publication, explicitly qualified by incomplete information.
The intended capability is unrestricted everyday autonomous driving. However, the speaker supplies no measure of closeness to that capability.
Testing whether unrestricted driving was already available would replace his qualified judgment about proximity with a different claim about availability.
criteria.support_condition: No objective support condition preserves both the explicit epistemic qualifications and the undefined degree of closeness.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No objective contradiction condition can be specified without converting the tentative assessment into a firm readiness claim or supplying a closeness threshold.
